notes.title: Patch - 6.29.25
notes.content:
New patch! Thanks to your feedback:

- Fixed error that made SFX volume impossible to adjust in options menu.
- Fixed endless battle glitch in mid-game sequence.
- Rebalanced difficulty slightly in later game encounters to match early game challenge.
- Made Diamond Hardplate equippable.

An additional note: Recently, new updates have occasionally led to save files being lost. If this happens to you, please follow the instructions in the previous update regarding restoring save files.

If you are having this issue, the magnanimous Francesco Funiati has laid out some steps to restore your file:

1. Create a copy of the folder with all the existing save states (Program Files / Steam / Steamapps / Common / Content / Save)

2. Call it "save - Copy" or whatever, and put it in the same folder where "save" is located

3. This will be your backup

4. After that, start the game

5. The game (for this unknown reason) won't recognize the save states, so you need to start a new game

6. Proceed up to the first save point (where Santos is) and save in the same slots where you used to have your previous save files (So, for example, if you had 10 save files in the slots from 1 to 10, create ten new saves, in the slots from 1 to 10)

7. After that, return to the main menu and, WITHOUT exiting the game

8. Replace the new save files with the ones you originally had (and backed up in the "save - Copy" folder)

9. You should be able to load them

10. After that, I highly suggest saving right after loading the save file in order to fully restore the save

Feel free to reach out if you are having further issues. My apologies and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Large Update 6/30/2024
notes.content:
Hello!  In addition to ongoing bug fixes, difficulty tweaks, and dialogue fixes thanks to the amazing Steam community and the almighty Francesco Funiati, an extra feature has been added to Grand Soul Story: 

[b]Sneaking missions now offer a "Pre-emptive Strike" feature, where sneaking up on enemies from behind gives the party an extra turn as well as a +25 SP boost! Thanks to Dumboo for the suggestion![/b]

Additionally, the "breathing" animation has been cut from the game as an aesthetic choice and as a way to (hopefully) improve performance for some players.

Feel free to share your thoughts on the changes!

May you be one with the One!

notes.title: Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
Grand Soul Saga is officially out of early access! The following changes were implemented based on player feedback:

- Retune the battle system to make battles less drawn out.
- Fix jumping mechanic such that out-of-bounds areas are inaccessible.
- Add at least 5 new cutscenes to enhance character development and relationships between main cast.
- Minor bug fixes.
- Make certain graphical assets more congruent with the overall pixel art presentation.

Grand Soul Saga will continue to receive ongoing updates to improve the experience based on user feedback, but the larger scale Early Access goals have been met.
